svg.title: Flappy V4 Alpha 46 — Blue Hour Range mixed alpine conifer forest — UNAPPROVED study
svg.desc: Editable source-paint study only. Individually positioned original fir, spruce and larch trees with physical trunks, coherent branching, differentiated foliage and sparse handmade value accents. No external resources or runtime changes. Human iPhone visual acceptance required.
